# E0253: a new version comes before the newest published version

Versions are only appended: a new version comes after the newest published
one. Here 0.0 and 1.0 were published, and the candidate adds 0.1 between them,
so the published 1.0 would no longer follow the version it was published
after.

## Example

`candidate/ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	size: int & <10
}
```

`candidate/ship/history/0.1.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	size: int & <20
}

BackwardLens: {
	v0_1: _
	v0_0: {
		size: 0
	}
	lacunas: {
		size: [{
			type:    Placeholder
			message: "0 is a placeholder"
		}]
	}
}
```

`candidate/ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	size: string
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_1: _
	v1_0: {
		size: "unknown"
	}
	lacunas: {
		size: [{
			type:    Placeholder
			message: "unknown is a placeholder"
		}]
	}
}

BackwardLens: {
	v1_0: _
	v0_1: {
		size: 0
	}
	lacunas: {
		size: [{
			type:    Placeholder
			message: "0 is a placeholder"
		}]
	}
}
```

`published/ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	size: int & <10
}
```

`published/ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	size: string
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		size: "unknown"
	}
	lacunas: {
		size: [{
			type:    Placeholder
			message: "unknown is a placeholder"
		}]
	}
}

BackwardLens: {
	v1_0: _
	v0_0: {
		size: 0
	}
	lacunas: {
		size: [{
			type:    Placeholder
			message: "0 is a placeholder"
		}]
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0253]: new version 0.1 comes before published version 1.0
 --> history/0.1.thema:1:1
  |
1 | Schema: {
  | ^^^^^^
  |
  = note: versions are only appended: a new version comes after the newest published one, 1.0, so that every published version keeps its predecessor
  = help: remove the schema in history/0.1.thema, and make the change in a version after 1.0
```
